**Finding: compliant (preferred position met).**

The Agreement contains no employee non-solicitation or no-hire covenant. Searches for "solicit", "non-solicitation", "recruit", "hire", "employ or engage", "induce" and "offer of employment" returned no restrictive-covenant hits, and the covenant-bearing provisions (Article VIII Certain Covenants, Governance, Representations/Warranties/Covenants, General Provisions) contain none. The only restriction on Ono in Article VIII is the Section 8.2 Competing Product exclusivity, which falls under the exclusivity rule and is not double-flagged here. Since Ono bears no non-solicitation restriction, the preferred position is satisfied and no redline was proposed.
